$comment: Historical checksum drift allowlist. Entries here re-classify a specific (migration_name, recorded_checksum, on_disk_checksum) triple from CHECKSUM_MISMATCH back to APPLIED without touching _prisma_migrations rows or historical SQL. Anything else stays CHECKSUM_MISMATCH and continues to block migration execution. Runtime (backend TS) and CI (assert-migration-drift-allowlisted.mjs) both read THIS file.

entries.reason: Migration file edited after being applied (git 4aa36bc -> e9bbeda) to reseed 76x50 instead of 120x80. The forward migration 20260928010000_reconcile_thermal_template_variants converges the seed row from either historical state to variant C. Recorded checksum stays as-is on every installation.
CRLF vs LF encoding only; the SQL bytes are semantically identical.
